notes.dishes: Dishes are computed from their ingredient recipes, not estimated at dish level. Recipes are stated assumptions -- see data/build_catalog.py -- so any individual gram figure can be argued with directly.
notes.ingredients: Each ingredient is one USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy food, cited by fdcId, per 100 g.
notes.market: Market prices are seed defaults, not survey data. Every one is editable in the interface, because a price that is wrong for your campus makes the recommendation wrong for you.
notes.proxies: Rows marked proxy have no SR Legacy equivalent and use a named substitute. They are flagged in the interface rather than presented as measured.
